title: Digital interventions for healthy and sustainable eating: a systematic review and meta-analysis
core_idea: To evaluate the effectiveness of digital interventions in increasing plant-based food consumption or reducing animal-based intake and to identify participant and intervention characteristics associated with greater effectiveness, by systematically reviewing quasi-experimental and longitudinal studies and coding interventions for behavior change techniques.
tldr: Systematic review and meta-analysis examining whether digital interventions can promote healthier and more sustainable eating (increase plant-based or reduce animal-based consumption) and which participant or intervention features relate to larger effects; studies were identified via comprehensive database searches and assessed for risk of bias.
